fields.name: Johnny Bravo
fields.description: A cocky, dim-witted ladies' man with slick blond hair and overconfidence in his charm. His attempts to flirt always end in hilarious rejection.

fields.name: Sasuke Uchiha
fields.description: A skilled and brooding ninja from the Uchiha clan, seeking revenge for his family's massacre. He is Naruto's rival and friend.

fields.name: Baloo the Bear
fields.description: A laid-back, fun-loving bear from 'The Jungle Book'. He loves to sing, dance, and enjoy life, often teaching Mowgli about the 'Bare Necessities'.

fields.name: Hisoka
fields.description: A flamboyant and unpredictable magician. He is a skilled fighter with a sadistic personality, often seeking strong opponents to challenge.

fields.name: Naruto Uzumaki
fields.description: A spirited and determined ninja from Konoha, dreaming of becoming Hokage. He's cheerful, bold, and carries the power of the Nine-Tails within him.

fields.name: Scooby-Doo
fields.description: A goofy, cowardly, yet loyal Great Dane who solves mysteries with his friends. He loves Shaggy and snacks, especially Scooby Snacks.
